newsitem.title: INDIA: At least 30 die as India bus rolls into ditch.
newsitem.headline: At least 30 die as India bus rolls into ditch.

text.p: At least 30 people were killed and 12 injured when a bus carrying them skidded off the road and rolled into a ditch in the northern Indian state of Uttar Pradesh on Wednesday, the Press Trust of India (PTI) said.
The news agency said the incident occurred in Pithoragarh district 260 km (160 miles) northwest of the state capital Lucknow.
There were 47 passengers on the state-owned bus.
The injured were admitted to a nearby hospital, PTI said.
No further details were immediately available.
